title: Exhaustion of a live window run
statement: Let $M$ be a Boolean-input Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $s$ be a natural-number window radius, and let $\mathrm{upd}$ be an update rule on an accumulator type $T$ and an optional Boolean. For every natural number $N$, initial configuration $c$, and accumulator $\tau$, suppose the machine is not halted at any time $u<N$ and its configuration is in the window of radius $s$ at every time $u\le N$. Then the window run with clock $N$ returns the exhausted outcome and its configuration component is exactly the configuration reached by $M$ after $N$ steps from $c$.
